name: resqnet
description: RESQNET — offline-first disaster response & emergency coordination platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @resqnet/backend" "npm run dev -w @resqnet/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @resqnet/shared && npm run build -w @resqnet/backend && npm run build -w @resqnet/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @resqnet/shared && npm run test -w @resqnet/backend && npm run test -w @resqnet/frontend
